_about: Player-facing writing that is not owned by an item, npc or quest: the intro, readable documents and examine text. A document with `lore: true` makes you Inspired the first time you read it (boons.json).
intro: You came up the Fallen Road for work, not glory. A blacksmith named Mara Venn will pay for word of a missing iron delivery. That is reason enough.

torn_page.title: A Torn Page
body: Half a page, torn from a ledger, trodden into the road
...paid in full for the bells, six, small. Hollin's man to take them up the Fallen Road and leave them where he is told, and not at the chapel, whatever the priest says.
The hedge-lads to keep the road quiet while it is done. Pay them in the new silver. They will not ask where it comes from. They never do.
Below, pressed into the paper rather than written: a circle with a line drawn across it, like an eye kept shut.

blackhedge_orders.title: Folded Orders
body: A square of good paper, folded small, in a hand far neater than any Blackhedge man's
Keep the drain at Ashby's running foul until the harvest is in and the farms are at each other's throats. Folk who hate their neighbours do not look up the road.
Take what pigs you like. Let Corrick blame Ashby. Let the reeve blame you, if he must; you will be paid for the trouble.
It is sealed with black wax, pressed with a closed eye.

manifest.title: Carriage Manifest
body:
HOLLIN & DAUGHTERS, CARTERS
Fallen Road toll, third day of Thawmonth
Consignment: grave-iron, twelve nine bars, bearing the mark of Venn's forge.
For: the quartermaster at the old watch post, Ashford Rise.
Driver:              — scored out hard enough to tear the paper.
Also carried: six bells, small, for the chapel.

Along the margin, in a different hand:
“Not the bells. Whatever he tells you, the bells do not go into the ground at Hallow Cut. Bring them back with the iron.”

examine.cart: A merchant cart, dragged off the road and abandoned. One wheel is gone and the chest in the bed has been forced. Whoever did it was not interested in the iron.
examine.waymarker: An old road marker. The distance to the watch post has been chiselled away, and someone has scratched a small bell beneath it.
examine.hallow_cut: Timber grave markers, newer than anything else on this road. A small bell hangs from each. The earth around them has been turned recently.
examine.watch_post: The door of the watch post is barred from the outside. Nobody has come or gone in some time.
examine.blackwood_edge: A standing stone at the edge of the pines, older than the road. A rune on its face gives off a cold green light, and fresh claw marks score its base.
examine.hound_den: Gnawed bones, some of them still in boots. The barrow wolves den here, and they do not like visitors.
examine.archer_camp: A smashed crate stamped with the watch tower. Arrows, no bowstrings, and a cold fire. The archers here stopped needing to eat some time ago.
examine.seer_stones: A ring of stones lit with witchlight. Grave-iron bars have been driven into the earth at its heart, nine of them, in a circle. So this is where Mara's iron went.
examine.shrine_first: The candles are fresh and someone has left bread in the bowl this morning. Whoever keeps this shrine is not far away.
examine.well: The well is deep and the water sweet. Someone has scratched the names of the drowned along the rim; the list stops forty years ago.
examine.ashby_field: Barley, or what was barley. The stalks have gone grey and slick, and the ground under them is black and smells of a cellar. It is worst at the south end, by the hedge, and fades the further north you walk.
examine.boundary_stone: The old stone that marks where Ashby land ends and Corrick land begins. The turf around its foot has been lifted and laid back, more than once, by someone careful. Underneath is a hollow just big enough for a letter.
examine.ashby_drain: A stone culvert mouth, half sunk in the bank. Black water seeps out of it into the Ashby barley. It runs back under the hedge, under Corrick land, to the old graves on the hill. The capstones have been lifted and set back, and not long ago: the moss is torn. In the mud there are boot prints, big and hobnailed. Not a farmer's.
examine.blackhedge_camp: From behind the rock you can see the camp: a fire, a lean-to, crates from carts that never reached Brackenford. Six of them that you can count, knotted black rags round their arms, and a big man in a red coat who never sits down. They are better armed than you and there are more of them. Not today.
examine.harl_strongbox: Under the coin and the cheap rings, a letter, sealed in grey wax pressed with a closed eye: 'For the Ashby business. Sour the ground, set the two houses at each other, and the land will come cheap. Payment as agreed. Further work to follow.' It is not signed.
examine.blackhedge_pigpen: A pen of hurdles behind the camp, and three fat pigs in it, every one with a notch cut in its left ear. Somebody is eating well on Bram Corrick's account.
examine.fairy_ring: A ring of pale toadstools that glow faintly, brighter when you look away. The grass inside is greener than it has any right to be. At the edge someone has left a saucer of milk and a coffin nail bent into a hook: the old way of asking the Gentry a favour, or of paying one back.

title._about: The title screen and character creation: the build label, the tagline, the classes shown on the create screen (a class with an archetype is playable; one without is shown as coming later), and the name pools for the random name button.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.blurb: Steel, shield and stubbornness. The last one standing.
traits: Strong: area damage, long fights. Weak: escaping, ranged foes

classes.name: Rogue
classes.blurb: Strike from the shadows. Gone before they fall.
traits: Strong: single-target burst, control. Weak: packs, long fights

classes.name: Ranger
classes.blurb: Bow, trap and hound. The wild is your weapon.
traits: Strong: control, fire spread, escaping. Weak: being cornered

classes.name: Occultist
classes.blurb: Rot and ruin. Your foes die slowly. You don't.
traits: Strong: spread damage, survival. Weak: burst, moving fights

classes.name: Paladin
classes.blurb: Holy fury in heavy plate. Unmoving. Unbreakable.
traits: Strong: big crits, toughness. Weak: speed, chasing
